acceptance: On Polars 2.0.0 and on 1.44.2, benchbox run --platform polars-df at SF 0.01 completes for tpch, tpcds, ssb and clickbench with zero failed queries and the expected query count per benchmark (no zero-query runs)
python -m benchbox.core.equivalence.cross_surface --benchmark <b> reports no divergences beyond cross_surface_baseline.yaml for all four benchmarks on both 2.0.0 and 1.44.2

Both cast_date implementations (adapter and unified_frame) use an API available on every supported version, and unit tests cover String, Date, Datetime, null and invalid input on 1.44.2 and 2.0.0, plus an AMPLab DataFrame query case
Readers pass no removed keyword on 2.0 (rechunk, missing_utf8_is_empty_string); any capability-detected keyword translation is tested on both sides and listed in the PR body
The PR body lists every 2.0 removal or default change checked against BenchBox code with file:line, and every added sort per query

A CI job installs exactly polars==2.0.0 over the locked environment and runs the polars-df SF 0.01 smoke and the four cross-surface gates; it is wired into the required core aggregate and passes alongside the existing locked-version (1.44.2) jobs
uv.lock, the pyproject polars floor and the main checkout's environment are unchanged; existing CI is green

description:
Polars 2.0.0 (released 2026-10-06) is a breaking release, and BenchBox's polars-df surface has only been exercised on 1.x (uv.lock 1.44.2, floor polars>=1.35.2). Make TPC-H, TPC-DS, SSB and ClickBench run and match their SQL reference on 2.0.0 while still passing on 1.44.2.

Known 2.0 changes that affect us (Polars 2 upgrade guide, docs.pola.rs/releases/upgrade/2/; source docs/source/releases/upgrade/2.md at py-2.0.0):
- String-to-temporal cast via cast(pl.Date) is rejected; use str.to_date(). This breaks polars_df.py cast_date AND unified_frame.py UnifiedExpr.cast_date (both column.cast(pl.Date)).
- scan_csv/scan_parquet rechunk= removed (polars_df.py read_csv/read_parquet pass it). scan_csv missing_utf8_is_empty_string= removed; replacement empty_string_is_null= (inverted) exists only from 1.44.x, so no common keyword covers 1.35.2-2.0.0.
- collect() defaults to the streaming engine, which does not guarantee row order for joins, group_by or unpivot.
- profile() removed; read_csv n_threads, batch_size, sample_size and rechunk removed; horizontal concat requires equal heights; Int+UInt64 supertype becomes Int128; decimal round, ceil and floor widen precision.
- Out-of-core spilling is on by default, at 80% of RAM.

Guardrails:
- Work in a separate git worktree with its own virtual environment. Never install Polars 2.0 into the main checkout's environment, and do not change uv.lock or the pyproject polars floor in this item.
- One code path for every version: no `if pl.__version__ ...` branches. Where no API exists in every supported version (verified: the CSV empty-string keyword), a capability-detected keyword translation (inspect the function signature) is allowed; each one is listed in the PR body with a test on both sides. rechunk= is dropped from the readers on every version.
- Prefer order-insensitive comparison in harnesses. Add a sort to a query only where the benchmark's SQL text has ORDER BY (specification semantics), for every version, listed per query in the PR body.
- Read the full upgrade guide and the deprecation-removal table before editing; record any other call sites found.

Review amendments (D0 2026-10-07): codex C1, C13; agy A8, A12 (see pvm-d0 context).
